title: Registry admission accepted dynamic iframe srcDoc payloads

reproduction.example: export function EmbeddedDocument({ html }: { html: string }) { return <iframe sandbox="allow-scripts" srcDoc={html} />; }
reproduction.beforeFix: The registry gate returned pass because it checked iframe sandbox flags but did not inspect inline srcDoc documents or the dynamic source value.
reproduction.runtimeBoundary: The Sites preview policy includes frame-src 'none'; a desktop/mobile Chromium probe inserted a nested sandboxed srcDoc frame containing a postMessage script, and the message never reached the parent. The iframe sandbox remained active.

rootCause: Iframe source validation covered src URLs and sandbox flags but omitted srcDoc, an inline HTML document input that can carry executable markup when sandbox flags permit scripts.
remediation: Reject JSX srcDoc attributes and unresolved srcDoc spreads, and reject direct srcdoc assignment, setAttribute, Reflect.set, and defineProperty writes. Keep the preview frame-src 'none' policy and outer sandbox as runtime controls.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "dynamic iframe srcDoc payloads"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: dynamic JSX srcDoc was accepted
validation.targetedAfterFix: the same registry regression passes for JSX, direct property assignment, setAttribute, and Object.defineProperty
validation.browserProbe: pnpm exec playwright test --config tests/e2e/sites-preview.playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/sites-preview-csp.spec.ts -g "untrusted preview cannot send data" passed for desktop and mobile Chromium; nested srcDoc script did not execute and no external request was observed
